At $6.40, the base case is -7.3% per year over seven years on a risked asset payoff of $4.00 per share (not operating cash flow). Critical Metals is a pre-production explorer whose value rests on Tanbreez in Greenland (42% owned today), Wolfsberg lithium in Austria, and minority lithium stakes. FY2025 cash was only $7.

*Primary risk: The company cannot finance Tanbreez through definitive feasibility study and construction without dilutive equity or adverse GEM settlement, while Greenland or technical setbacks impair the resource option.
*Lens failure mode (asset): Treating company PEA ~$3 billion net present value as per-share net asset value without probability, tax, financing, and dilution haircuts.
